name: Surplus Intelligence
description: A from-chat dashboard for your Surplus Intelligence inference account: prices, models, your API key, USDC balance/allowance, and savings (no wallet needed to buy). You buy inference by using your key as an OpenAI-compatible provider at <base>/api/inference/v1 in your own client — run /inference_provider for the setup. Also manages the seller side: mint/list/revoke seller keys and create/price/pause/cancel offers (per-token or discount pricing), probe your provider, discover sellable models, and track earnings (you resell a supported provider's inference; earnings settle in USDC to your payout address).
author: ProlowN <robin334@protonmail.com>
setupHints: Set INFERENCE_API_URL to the Surplus Intelligence API host you intend to use (https required, http only for localhost). Defaults to https://www.surplusintelligence.ai. Seller commands talk to SI's v1 API origin (derived automatically; override with INFERENCE_API_ORIGIN for self-hosted setups).
Browsing the market (/inference_prices, /inference_models) needs no credentials.

BUYING: create an inf_ key in the dashboard (https://www.surplusintelligence.ai/buy), add USDC to your wallet, approve spend there, and set the key as INFERENCE_API_KEY. To actually buy, use that key as an OpenAI-compatible provider at <INFERENCE_API_URL>/api/inference/v1 in your client — run /inference_provider for the setup. This plugin does not send inference itself.

SELLING: run /inference_seller_key once to mint a seller key (it generates a one-time wallet, signs, then discards it), and set the result as INFERENCE_SELLER_API_KEY. Creating offers also needs INFERENCE_SELLER_PROVIDER (which supported provider you resell), INFERENCE_SELLER_PROVIDER_API_KEY (that provider's key), and INFERENCE_SELLER_PAYOUT_ADDRESS (your wallet for USDC earnings).
Treat INFERENCE_API_KEY, INFERENCE_SELLER_API_KEY, and INFERENCE_SELLER_PROVIDER_API_KEY as secrets — they are not logged.

INFERENCE_API_ORIGIN.description: Surplus Intelligence v1 API origin used by the seller commands. Usually leave unset: SI hosts map to https://api.surplusintelligence.ai automatically, and any other INFERENCE_API_URL serves both. Set it only for split-host self-hosted deployments.

INFERENCE_API_KEY.description: Your Surplus Intelligence API key (inf_…) created in the dashboard (SI labels it a "buyer key"). One key, two uses: the provider key your client sends to buy inference, and what this plugin reads your account/usage with.

INFERENCE_SELLER_API_KEY.description: Seller API key (si_seller_…). Mint one with /inference_seller_key, or paste an existing one. Authorizes the seller commands.

INFERENCE_SELLER_PROVIDER.description: Which supported upstream provider you resell from. The plugin maps it to the offer's base URL (SI only allows these providers).

INFERENCE_SELLER_PROVIDER_API_KEY.description: The upstream provider API key you are reselling. Sent to SI's seller offer endpoint as the offer's key; SI proxies buyer traffic to your provider with it.

INFERENCE_SELLER_PAYOUT_ADDRESS.description: Your wallet address (0x…) where USDC earnings from your offers settle.
